description: This file defines serialization logic for the CultureInfo class, including a serializer class (CultureInfoCodec), a surrogate type (CultureInfoSurrogate), and a copier class (CultureInfoCopier).

classes.name: CultureInfoCodec
classes.description: Serializer for CultureInfo objects, converting to and from CultureInfoSurrogate.

classes.name: CultureInfoSurrogate
classes.description: Surrogate data type used to serialize CultureInfo.

classes.name: CultureInfoCopier
classes.description: Class implementing shallow copying and derived type copying for CultureInfo objects.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a CultureInfoSurrogate to a CultureInfo object.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a CultureInfo object into a CultureInfoSurrogate.
